map.化肥利用率估算器 使用指南: Fertilizer use efficiency estimator user guide
map.化肥利用率估算器，用差减法估算氮磷钾当季利用率，评价施肥方案合理性，指导肥料减量: Fertilizer use efficiency estimator: estimate same-season N-P-K use efficiency by difference subtraction, evaluate fertilization plan rationality, guide fertilizer reduction and efficiency.
map.当季利用率 = (施肥区吸收量 − 对照区吸收量) ÷ 施入养分量 × 100%: Same-season use efficiency = (fertilized-zone uptake - control-zone uptake) / applied nutrient * 100%
map.经典差减法：以不施肥的对照区吸收量为本底，施肥区吸收量减本底即肥料贡献量，除以施: Classic difference method: take the uptake of the unfertilized control as baseline; the fertilized plot's uptake minus baseline is the fertilizer contribution, divided by the applied nutrient to get the current-season utilization rate. Grade by nutrient type (N/P/K) against different reference ranges (high/normal/low), and give improvement tips such as split application, deep placement with cover, and combined organic matter.
map.农学利用率 = (施肥产量 − 空白产量) / 施肥量。: Agronomic use efficiency = (fertilized yield - blank yield) / fertilizer amount.
map.或养分吸收利用率 = (施肥吸养 − 空白吸养) / 施肥量。: Or nutrient absorption use efficiency = (fertilized absorption - blank absorption) / fertilizer amount.
map.用于减肥增效与施肥方式优化评估。: Used to evaluate weight-loss efficiency and fertilization-method optimization.
map.：施 N 15 kg/亩比空白增产 180 kg/亩籽粒，农学利用率 = 180: : applying N 15 kg/mu yields 180 kg/mu more grain than the blank; agronomic utilization = 180/15 = 12 kg grain/kg N. Combined with grain nitrogen content, nutrient utilization is about 35%-40%, suggesting deep placement can raise it further.
map.农学利用率和养分利用率哪个更直观？: Which is more intuitive, agronomic or nutrient use efficiency?
map.农学利用率（kg 粮/kg 肥）农民好懂，反映『投入产出』；养分利用率是生理口径: Agronomic use efficiency (kg grain/kg fertilizer) is easy for farmers, reflects 'input-output'; nutrient use efficiency is physiological, for research benchmarking. Different caliber, not interchangeable.
map.深施覆土、分期追施、配缓控释肥、有机肥替代部分化肥、优化灌溉（水肥协同）。这些措: Deep placement with soil cover, split topdressing, slow-/controlled-release fertilizers, partial organic substitution for chemical fertilizer, and optimized irrigation (water-fertilizer synergy). These are the main paths of the 'reduce fertilizer, increase efficiency' approach.
